notes.title: Mac version of Math Classroom Challenge now available
notes.notes:
We are happy to inform that the Mac version of Math Classroom Challenge is now available. Designed with full pad compatibility, the game has the same features that you can find in Windows. 

Math Classroom Challenge is a game for children and youth, where the player can learn to solve different math problems in a funny way. Many schools and teachers are now using Math Classroom Challenge as a complement to show math to the children. We hope to go on adding new features very soon. Thank you!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32805464/693f560e8959b6e815ac0aab4100b276d6b990d9.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Teddy Bear version now available
notes.notes:
Hi there!

The new version "Teddy Bear" of Math Classroom Challenge is now available. 

This version includes the teddy bear in the Summer Area, where you can add points to the score while throwing water to him. When a gong sounds it indicates you have scored!

We are now updating the Xbox version too.

Have a nice math day!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32805464/fd890a8a25453141e0125d90850d1d51fb9d2cf1.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Version 1.88 with night scenario for "Save the seas"
notes.notes:
The new version 1.88 of Math Classroom Challenge is now at your disposal, with some enhancements and minor fixes. Also with a new night scenario that will popup sometimes in "Save the seas". 

We're now working on version 2.0 with new features including underwater operations for cleaning up plastics below the seas. Thank you for your interest and support.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32805464/9b958161a1420c48d31e96615c726befb248b821.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Version 1.87A with some minor fixes and "water polluted"
notes.notes:
We have included some minor fixes in version 1.87A of Math Classroom Challenge, being the most important the new behavior of speedboats.

But we've also included a new element: "Water polluted". Every time the player throws "math energy" to clean the plastics, the water gets polluted. So a new objective in the game is to avoid pollute the water too much. To achieve that, use the hose the minimum possible. That way you won't pollute the water too much. It's up to you again how to use this feature. 

Like everything else in the game you have the last choice. But we think it will be a good idea to save the seas from our own pollution when cleaning up plastics. Have a nice day saving whales and dolphins!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32805464/acacf3a1b7f9f11128013869b06784d9c7fa7dc9.png[/img]

notes.title: "Save the seas" final version released
notes.notes:
We're happy to inform that the release version of "Save the seas" is now online for download. This is the new scenario for "Math Classroom Challenge".

In this version we have added some important elements to the scenario. Now when breaking down the walls, debris and plastics will appear It's up to you to clean that plastics, but it will give you more points. Besides, more whales and dolphins will be freed.

"M" will turn on/off music. "U" will clear the HUD.

There are also a new yellow dot, that indicates plastic that contains life inside. If you clean that plastic, marine life will be freed from inside.

Now the first white dot will appear randomly, not only in front of the player. Just the initial games will do this. The helo can fly higher.

The game will generate more freed whales and dolphins when cleaning the seas and breaking down the walls.

Some minor tweaks have been added to the game. And we're working with the next version: underwater operations. Thank you for your support!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32805464/ce677df2608304b8b5d896a0cf0e065002a78075.png[/img]

notes.title: Main features and release date version 1.80
notes.notes:
This is the promotional image to inform about the development of Math Classroom Challenge V.1.80: Save the seas. Programming is going well after the main element of the game (helo and drone controls, views, interaction) are solved, and generation of debris and plastics are almost finished.

So we have planned to release this new version on August 15, 2018. We think there won't be any problem with this date. Of course new elements and refinements will be added later, and you can always suggest whatever you think might be of interest.

We’re now programming the whales and dolphins behavior. We'll be uploading images and videos (we already have some) on Twitter. Thank you for your interest.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32805464/119b4a1ec22b3469c6f6a52780b00487e4bea180.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Version 1.71 with minor fixes and numbers eaten
notes.notes:
Hello! 

We have released a minor release, 1.71, with minor fixes and the number of numbers eaten by Sam in the statistics panel. 

Meanwhile we continue the work with version 1.80 "Save the seas". Thank you and happy math!

notes.title: Release date moved to June 7
notes.notes:
Hello everyone and welcome to Math Classroom Challenge.

We have moved the release date to June 7, because we are working on some final elements with the Oculus version of the game, and we want to be sure everything is working as expected.

Meanwhile we are also adding some new features that were implemented in the AR version of the game, so you'll have a better final build at the day of the release.

Thank you and sorry for the delay, have a nice math day!
